why: ChatGPT's chart sorts by thrust and voltage and gives multi-battery answers ('2 × 12V 100Ah' for 24V, '3 × 12V' for 36V) next to single 24V/36V lithium packs, and it ends by asking which motor the shopper has. That is a real tradeoff between one 24V pack and two 12V batteries in series, and the motor's system voltage decides both the battery setup and the LiFePO4 charger voltage (14.6V, 29.2V or 43.8V); Redodo's store lists all of these, and ChatGPT showed no product card.
